name: JBG SMITH Properties
summary: JBG SMITH Properties owns, operates, and develops mixed-use properties concentrated in amenity-rich, Metro-served submarkets in and around Washington, DC, most notably National Landing, where through our focus on placemaking, we cultivate vibrant, highly amenitized, walkable neighborhoods. JBG SMITH's portfolio comprises 11.8 million square feet at share of multifamily, office, and retail assets, and a 3.5 million square-foot development pipeline. JBG SMITH Properties was established in 2016 and was incorporated in Maryland.
